## Overview

Episodes to cover:

## Setup:

This episode will describe the computational setup for this module.

## R wrangling:

This episode will cover some R basics (most likely already covered in first weeks of course by Emiel?)

- Based on carpentries + other tutorials
- Importing data into R
- Data frame manipulation using `dplyr`
- Making graphs using `ggplot2`

## Introduction to unix shell:

This episode will cover some unix shell basics to prepare for the RNA-seq and genome assembly section,

- Based on carpentries and other tutorials 
- Basic set of unix commands (e.g. cd, ls, etc)
- Continue with basic bioinformatics filetypes (`.fasta`, `.fastq`)
- Introduce sanity check concept
